_comment: Drives test/klippy/multi_mcu_stm32_stm32.test under a two-renode multi-bridge fan-out (stm32f103 main + stm32f407 satellite). The runner spawns one renode_launcher.py instance per bridge, each loading its own platform .repl and firmware ELF. tick_mode lockstep: klippy broadcasts each `advance T` to both renode tick sockets and waits for both `done` replies, so the two MCU clocks stay aligned with klippy's reactor - in free-run the independent wall-clock-bound renode clocks drift enough that G28 trips the trsync watchdog ('Communication timeout during homing'). Verified 4/4 with the renode tick path (sentinel-delimited monitor round-trips). auto_trsync_trigger_ticks fires the X/Y/Z endstops after 100 step edges so G28 completes; all stepper pins are on [mcu] so the pusher routes step_trigger to the main bridge's control socket.
